verdicts.argument: The bid does not provide any evidence that the two positions are distinct or that the contract text explicitly separates them.
No contract clause or specification distinguishes the disposal of non-reusable material from the general waste disposal provision.
The bid lacks any reference that would differentiate the excavation of soil from the general earthworks.
There is no textual basis to treat the frost protection layer delivery as separate from the general frost protection provision.
The contract text does not separate the removal of the upper soil layer from the general earthworks.
The bid does not supply additional details that would clarify the scope of site establishment beyond the generic statement.
No contract language distinguishes the loading and removal of upper soil from the general earthworks.
The bid does not provide any technical specification that would satisfy the required frost protection standards.
The contract text does not indicate that concrete work should be measured in square meters rather than volume.
The bid does not contain any specification of insulation thickness or thermal conductivity that would meet the required standards.
No contract detail specifies the pressure class, SDR, or standard reference for the PE‑HD pipe.
The bid does not provide any information on the homogeneous area as required by DIN 18300.
